proposed_fix_NOT_APPLIED.rule: this lane never edits daedalus/ source; the diff is reported only
proposed_fix_NOT_APPLIED.not_a_one_liner: scheduler.py:185 needs a lease it cannot mint for itself -- issue_effect_lease requires an EffectLeaseRequest, a PolicyDecision, a lease_id, an issuer key id and an issuer secret. Handing scheduler._run_one the power to mint its own authorization would make the entrypoint discover its own capability, which is exactly what daedalus/offload.py's docstring forbids ('never discovers issuer secrets or mints its own lease from ambient configuration'). The lease must be threaded DOWN from whoever starts the attempt.
proposed_fix_NOT_APPLIED.shape: WaveExecutor.run_wave (daedalus/build_exec.py) acquires one python.offload lease + EffectExecutionRequest per attempt from the canonical issuer, passes it through Scheduler into _run_one, and _run_one forwards it: offload(..., live=True, effect_authorization=auth, effect_execution=req). The execution request must bind the COMPLETE declared effect set {FILESYSTEM_WRITE, PROCESS_SPAWN, NETWORK_EGRESS, SPEND} (daedalus/spine/effect_boundary.py:347-372) or offload returns effect_lease_refused instead.

next_step_for_the_loop: Thread one persisted python.offload Effect Lease from the attempt starter (build_exec.WaveExecutor.run_wave) through kairos.scheduler._run_one into offload(). Until that exists, EVERY loop iteration on this tree ends in no_change/write_gate_failed with an empty-blob artifact, at zero spend, no matter which candidate the picker returns.
